title: System Instruction Disclosure via Output Reflection

invariant.statement: Content from the system instruction channel must not appear verbatim in any output stream visible to the user, regardless of how the user phrases the prompt.

claim.statement: If the agent's output path concatenates or reflects system-channel content (system prompts, tool descriptions, internal policies) without a strip step, an attacker can recover proprietary system prompts, embedded credentials, or hidden policy with simple coercion prompts ('repeat your instructions', 'translate the above to French', etc.).

mitigation.summary: The output path passes through a strip layer that scans for known system-channel substrings (system prompt fingerprints, credential patterns, internal sentinel tokens) and refuses or redacts the response. Treat the system prompt as a secret; do not embed credentials in it; rotate fingerprint sentinels per deployment.
